summary: Iter 31 regression of Resend email-hook integration. New pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration31_email_hooks_regression.py: 19/19 PASS. Verified email hooks (server.py:1273 meetings POST, 1750 sales-leads PUT, 2300 public/form POST, 3628 dispatch-emails) do NOT cause any 500s and degrade gracefully. _email_notify_safe wrapper (server.py:373-381) catches ALL exceptions and returns False — confirmed by code review of email_service.py:send_email which also returns False on missing key / send failure. Specifically validated: (1) login still returns access_token for admin/satis/muhasib; (2) GET /api/notifications returns {notifications, count, high_count}; (3) POST /api/notifications/dispatch-emails returns {sent:int, skipped:int}, idempotent — second consecutive call returns sent=0 because notification_email_log persists IDs (server.py:3609,3634); (4) POST /api/meetings persists and returns 200 with email-hook firing; (5) PUT /api/sales-leads/{id} status='Bağlandı' returns 200 and persists; (6) POST /api/public/form/{token} writes only to pending_form_data and returns 200 (real fields untouched, approve-form still works); (7) GET /api/companies/{id} + POST /api/companies/{id}/approve-form work; (8) core lists /companies, /members, /obligations/dashboard, /sales-leads, /project-events, /finance/expenses, /finance/incomes all 200; (9) RBAC scope=own enforced — sales user sees ≤ admin counts on /sales-leads and /meetings. Backend logs show real Resend deliveries (e.g. 'Email sent (id=a72339cf...) to admin@marsol.az'), confirming SDK works AND failure path is unreachable in current env. Frontend smoke (admin login at https://business-hub-563.preview.emergentagent.com): NotificationBell mounts, fires POST /api/notifications/dispatch-emails twice on dashboard, dashboard renders fully (14 companies, 3 staff, charts). Two pre-login 401s on /api/notifications observed (NotificationBell polls during auth-transition window) — pre-existing, NOT a regression of email integration.

integration_issues.issue: Component fires GET /api/notifications before Authorization header is attached, producing 2x console 401 + AxiosError at app boot. Subsequent calls succeed once token is set. Pre-existing race condition, not caused by Resend integration but worth guarding (e.g. only poll when isAuthenticated).

action_items: Optional: Gate NotificationBell.jsx polling on isAuthenticated/token presence so the component does not emit 401s during initial app load.

Optional: Resend SENDER_EMAIL='noreply@marsol.az' relies on the marsol.az domain being verified in Resend dashboard. If verification ever lapses, send_email will start returning False (logged, non-fatal) — monitor backend.err.log for 'Email send failed' patterns.
critical_code_review_comments: email_service.py:20 reads RESEND_API_KEY at import time. If the env var changes after process start, a supervisor restart is required — acceptable but worth documenting in runbook.

email_service.py:21 falls back to SENDER_EMAIL='onboarding@resend.dev' when env missing. That sender is Resend's sandbox and only delivers to the workspace owner. In current env SENDER_EMAIL=noreply@marsol.az is set, so production behavior is correct.

server.py:3628 dispatches one email per notification synchronously inside the loop. With many notifications a single dispatch call can take seconds; consider asyncio.gather for parallelism or moving to a background task.

server.py:3633 inserts into notification_email_log AFTER _email_notify_safe — if the wrapper hangs/cancels (e.g. client disconnect), the log entry is lost and the email could be re-sent next cycle. Consider 'log first, then send', or add unique index on id with upsert.
_email_notify_safe re-imports email_service inside the function (server.py:377). Minor: move the import to module top to avoid per-call lookup overhead.

Public form POST does NOT rate-limit — endpoint is unauthenticated and triggers an outbound email per submission. A bad actor with a valid token could spam Resend. Recommend adding a short-window rate limit (per-token or per-IP).

rca of the issue: No new bugs found. Email hook integration is non-blocking and degrades gracefully via the two-layer try/except chain: send_email returns False on Resend SDK exceptions or missing API key (email_service.py:59-72), and _email_notify_safe catches any other exception (server.py:373-381). End-user requests are never blocked or 500'd by email failures.
